fields.reason: Both completed PRIMARY trials are weak: flattened-pixel logistic C=0.1 overfits severely (train 1.0, search 0.39375), while gradient-histogram logistic improves search only to 0.4 with a smaller but still large gap. A frozen pretrained encoder with a linear classifier is the most promising available route to test richer image representations without training a deep model.
fields.review: Trial 1 shows high-capacity pixel logistic overfitting; trial 2 reduces overfit but remains near 0.4 accuracy. The available MobileNet candidate changes representation rather than only regularization, so it is a reasonable next PRIMARY search candidate. This is not proof of improvement, and the 64x64 stretched input may not match the encoder's expected preprocessing.
